violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil ice scoop was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Ice scoop needs to be stored, when not in use in a container not on top of ice machine.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Microwave next to Reach-in-freezers needs cleaned.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. All reach-in-freezers need cleaned of Food debris.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory in cooking area was used for purpose other than handwashing. Do not store items in Handwashing sink.
Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying.
Toilet facilities. — --- Toilet & shower room was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. - Parts of the ceiling above 3-Comp Sink is flaking. Ceiling and wall around fryer/grill in need of cleaning. - Ceiling above kitchen/prep areas need to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Currently popcorn type ceiling.
